mapper.insert: INSERT INTO growth_evidence_projection_cursor ( user_id, source_key, cursor_time, cursor_source_id, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{sourceKey}, #{cursorTime}, #{cursorSourceId}, NOW(), NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE cursor_time = CASE WHEN VALUES(cursor_time) > cursor_time OR (VALUES(cursor_time) = cursor_time AND VALUES(cursor_source_id) > cursor_source_id) THEN VALUES(cursor_time) ELSE cursor_time END, cursor_source_id = CASE WHEN VALUES(cursor_time) > cursor_time OR (VALUES(cursor_time) = cursor_time AND VALUES(cursor_source_id) > cursor_source_id) THEN VALUES(cursor_source_id) ELSE cursor_source_id END, update_time = NOW()
